carryon_allowance.value: 2 carry-on/valet articles, 1 standard article and 1 personal article, for a total maximum weight of 44 pounds (22 pounds each).
carryon_allowance.notes: From Pacific Coastal's Q&A on the checked-baggage policy effective May 1, 2017; the page gives no carry-on dimensions.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: Pre-paid fees apply up to 24 hours before departure; check-in fees apply when you pay within 24 hours of departure, online or at the airport.

size_weight.value: A checked bag is one item up to 50 pounds (23 kilograms) and 62 inches (158 cm) in linear dimensions, wheels and handles included. Single bags over 70lbs are not accepted; a maximum of three checked bags per passenger.

fees_by_fare.value: Fees including GST: Basic and Bravo fares pay for the 1st bag (Pre-Paid $36.75, Check-In $47.25); Classic includes the 1st bag and the 2nd costs Pre-Paid $57.75 / Check-In $68.25; Encore includes 2 bags. A 3rd bag or an oversized/overweight bag costs Pre-Paid $105 / Check-In $115.50 on every fare.

military.value: Canadian Military personnel (former or current) can check two bags, up to 50lbs and/or 62” linear dimensions each, at no charge with valid military ID; not extended to family members.

modules.title: What the cheapest fare includes
modules.lede: For Basic fares, checking in late or making any change results in a no-show and forfeiture of the segment.

basic_fare.notes: Pacific Coastal's fare page labels Basic as the entry fare, but an older Q&A on its site calls Bravo the lowest fare. Which fare is cheapest is ambiguous, so nothing is published until a re-capture settles it.

24_hour_refund.notes: Pacific Coastal's fare page labels Basic as the entry fare, but an older Q&A on its site calls Bravo the lowest fare. Which fare is cheapest is ambiguous, so nothing is published until a re-capture settles it.

modules.title: Check-in and airport cutoffs
modules.lede: Payload limits mean checked baggage cannot always travel on the same flight.

bag_drop_cutoff.value: Drop checked bags at the check-in counter 60 minutes before departure (recommended); bags dropped 40 minutes or less before departure are not accepted.

phone_home_market.notes: Pacific Coastal's reservations and call centre number on its fare terms page.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: These are standards published by the carrier for delays and cancellations. On codeshares or interline itineraries, the operating carrier is responsible.

care.value: When a flight is delayed or cancelled within carrier control, passengers are entitled to meals, refreshments, communication access, and hotel accommodation with transport for overnight delays.

rebooking_refund.value: For disruptions within carrier control, the airline rebooks passengers on the next available flight or provides a full refund for unused flight segments if delayed by 3 hours or more.

compensation.value: Statutory or policy compensation applies for cancellations or long delays within carrier control according to applicable aviation passenger rights regulations.
